items.heading: Chicken Tagine
details: Key ingredients: chicken, preserved lemon, olives, ginger, saffron, onion
Brown chicken pieces with onion, ginger and saffron in a tagine or heavy pot.
Add a little water or stock and simmer gently, covered, until tender.
Stir in preserved lemon and olives near the end of cooking.
Serve with couscous or crusty bread.

items.heading: Couscous
details: Key ingredients: couscous, mixed vegetables, chickpeas, lamb or chicken, ras el hanout
Steam couscous over a pot of simmering stew until light and fluffy.
Simmer meat, vegetables and chickpeas with ras el hanout until tender.
Fluff the couscous with a little butter or oil.
Mound the couscous on a platter and top with the stew.

items.heading: Harira Soup
details: Key ingredients: lentils, chickpeas, tomato, celery, lamb, fresh herbs
Brown small pieces of lamb with onion and celery.
Add tomato, lentils, chickpeas and water, then simmer until tender.
Stir in fresh cilantro and parsley near the end.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon, traditionally to break the Ramadan fast.
